title: Controlling Anger upon the Guidance of the Prophet ﷺ
summary: The Prophet ﷺ guided the angry person to seek refuge in Allah from Shaytan (Sahih al-Bukhari 3282); and he ﷺ said: «The strong one is not the one who overcomes others in wrestling; the strong one is the one who controls himself when angry» (Sahih al-Bukhari 6114). Teach your child that anger is natural, but it has tools: to seek refuge in Allah, to keep silent instead of saying hurtful words, and to sit down until they calm down. Be a model in your own calmness first.
try_this: Today: Teach your child to sit down if they get angry while standing, and do it yourself in front of them.
reflection_prompts: How does your child express their anger?
Did the new tool help them?
